# Melee build

Forge code

## Build Notes
This build is all about swing at the enemy and killing them before they kill you. You almost always end up taking a 1v5 fight. You obviously want to try and single a squishy out but that is not always easy or practical. Hiding around corners is the best strategy as MANY people will be caught slacking and walk right into your 2-tap hammer. With the recent additional hp buffs to many items, it can be difficult to maintain enough damage to 2 tap someone. This is an important breakpoint as you can delay your first swing and speed up your second to make them hit in very quick succession leaving no room for supports to react. If you are not in this range, you are at risk. [Fire Strike](ability_446d4178-b24b-4b4c-9d1b-3064677eea0e) is used to attack a fleeing target or fliers. It will not be efficient to use up close. It can maybe be used prefight to spam a choke in an attempt to hit multiple people. Colosseo and Hanaoka fist fight come to mind. Even this becomes useless in later rounds.

## Round 1
- Power: [Feeling The Burn](item_256f9e9c-c332-42f2-83d9-ad0d47e23399)
This item will add significant damage to your swing. A major tip for this is to prime the empowered swing before engaging. This is done by swing 2 times indicated by your hammer glowing blue. This is the same visual as [Mercy](hero_0e213bfc-3ca9-49c6-9036-e7f344b752da) damage boost. There is an additional audio queue in case you are getting damage boosted, but it can be hard to hear.

-Items: Standard Round 1 items for [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49) Most weapon buffs are good and [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) is amazing for [Move Speed](stat_move_speed). [Frenzy Amplifier](item_d4b0cfcb-14e9-4472-a688-680120217250)gives perfect stats for [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49) but it is difficult to find value from it. The one exception is [Clone Conjuration](item_6c9f6be1-ab29-4f46-af24-34e4835f9af3) as each clone will get 1 tap and count towards the buff. Its about 50/50 if a [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) takes [Two-Zu](item_80f16d3e-a4c0-4fa8-90b1-a0f033a1a77b) or [Clone Conjuration](item_6c9f6be1-ab29-4f46-af24-34e4835f9af3). Absolutely do NOT take [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49) does not have a quick melee. I am shocked that after 6 months people are still taking this item on [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49). IF it worked, it would be so broken that I would consider keeping it in round 7. It would equate to at least 15% [Weapon Lifesteal](stat_weapon_lifesteal)
## Round 2
Items: [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) is the perfect item. every stat is very useful. However, it does not give you the most dps increase for 10000 cash. Also don't sleep on the 50 armor it gives. If you want to take more damage, choose from these items: [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054), [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a), [Wrist Wraps](item_19183386-c859-42ca-93f2-355d47d01e36). I have stopped taking [Shieldbuster](item_9ee1f150-537d-40b9-b975-7820fb1c6a66) due to its inconsistency, but it is still good for 4000. Just remember that almost every rare item can be replaced by 2 or 3 common items to give similar or better stats. 1 Major exception is [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054). Yes, you could get similar stats but would you rather have  to spend 3500 cash and 3 slots taken up or spend 3750 cash and free up 2 of those slots. I am shocked that this item has not been nerfed to 4000. I think this is because ammo heroes tend to favor [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) over [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed). Keep this in mind as items that gives [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) will give [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49) disproportional value.

-Playstyle: don't change much from Round 1. You might be able to 2 tap a squishy so keep that in mind. Always be looking at the enemy builds before and during a round if you have to.

## Round 3

-Power: You could take [Smashing!](item_a7021e28-cb8a-4f39-aeb1-380525b3fea9) but I find it impossible to get value out of unless it is the perfect scenario. I frequently just take [Vanguard](item_228cf103-0be8-4f1c-8780-f3a8d8676abf) as the sppedboost is nice. It acts very similar to a [Commanding Shout](ability_dfbb8e50-5815-42c8-8a6e-9bb20bf6cc59).

-items: At this point [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) is too valuable to skip. I recommend just maximizing dps with rare and common items. Try to use as much cash as possible while still use 5 or 6 slots.

# Turtle Rein Build [Complete Guide] 04.07.25

Forge code: VZWPB

## Build Notes
This was the best [Reinhardt] build to go for. This build is very good at stopping the enemy from gaining large amounts of cash.

Edit: Against certain builds you can delay the pivot for an additional round. Keep [Gloomgauntlet] and [Aftermarket Firing Pin]. With the rest of your money buy as many of the rare items mentioned in the previous round as well as [Heartbeat Sensor]. This build works well if you are against a Rein or if your team is not coordinated. An added benefit to this is that the enemy will pick their 3rd power before they know that you are pivoting to a shield build. Updated 4 July 2025

## Round 1 
Always start with [To Me, My Friends!] [Heartbeat Sensor] , [Weapon Grease] ,and [Compensator]

If the enemy is [Reinhardt] and takes [Smashing!] this is ideal, and you should win most match ups. you might be thinking "how do win if he has extra 10% move speed and 30% weapon lifesteal?"Just like [Ogundimu Reduction Field] the stats only last for 2 seconds. Just swing on [Reinhardt] 2 times then back away. It's just that easy. Since you can no longer have [Wilhelmwagen] round 1 this matchup is not as simple as it was before but it is still good for you if you play it right. Just don't swing on [Reinhardt] too much.

Tip: before this round starts you can let your team know that you are going shield build to incentivize them to go for a WP build.

Important note: you have to reach at least 10k after round 1 so you can afford [Gloomgauntlet].

## Round 2
Absolutely must get [Gloomgauntlet] . [Heartbeat Sensor] is best after that. [Aftermarket Firing Pin] is better than [Heartbeat Sensor], [Weapon Grease], and [Compensator] together. If you have between 13750-13999 get [Aftermarket Firing Pin]. At 14000 you could get [Frenzy Amplifier] but I don't like that the stats are inconsistent, but they are good enough to replace [Compensator] and If you get crazy money just min/max WP. at 17500+ [Iron Eyes] could be good against guaranteed crits like [Genji] melee build with [Ambusher Optics].

## Round 3
The power you choose here depends on the team comps. [Amplification Barrier] can be taken and possibly even swap over to a shield build if you team is coordinated. But like round 2 you want to still choose AD items almost every time. In a team with little to no projectiles [Barrier Reconstruction] can be taken for extra survivability. Make sure you get [Aftermarket Firing Pin]. [Heartbeat Sensor] is ideal but I will take both [Weapon Grease] and [Compensator] if this if the money works out. Try to have at least 5 slots filled because the common items give more value for their cost. without [Wilhelmwagen] you might need to get max movement speed. if you have enough get [Vanadium Injection] for the 10% movement speed. At this point you need to focus on objective rather than generating money as this build is not money hungry. You want to win at least 2 of the 3 rounds as round 6 will be tough to win. Round 7 should be relatively easy as long as your team has 2 brain cells.

## Round 4
This is where we do a full pivot to turtle Reinhardt. Sell all of your items and buy [Wilhelmwagen], [Martian Mender], [Overclocked Barrier]. [Heartbeat Sensor] and [Aftermarket Firing Pin] are still useful for movement speed. [First Aid Kit] is the best common option for this last slot. I don't think [Phoenix Protocol] is very good or necessary because [Barrier Reconstruction] is so good. you can get like 300 barrier hp per swing/firestike HIT. so multiple hits can lead to 1000 hp in less than 1 second. firestrikes should be used for regenerating barrier hp and easy eliminations. there is no need to use then on airborne targets as not getting the elimination could cause your shield to break faster.

## Round 5

I like to go [Rustung Von Wilhelm] along with [Heartbeat Sensor] . [Nebula Conduit] can work instead if the enemy team is not very deadly. for the last slot buy the best item you can afford: [First Aid Kit] , [Aftermarket Firing Pin] , or [Meka Z-Series] . I don't think [Ironclad Cleats] is necessary but Lucio can boop you if they build correctly.

The play style for this is to stand in front of the enemy tank as much as possible while still protecting your team from flankers and Juno torpedoes.

Your main kill potential is your Earthshatter. Use it as frequently as needed, and a solo shatter is often enough to win unless the enemy has a mercy. (still good idea to solo shatter if it feels hard to get more than 1 person)

Save your charge to stun enemies and kill dps/support that get overzealous. You also need to use charge to peel your backline and for movement. NEVER go for the 1v5 charge into the enemy team unless it is to touch point in overtime.

important matchups:

-Juno: always try to block as many torpedoes as you can as this will stop her from recharging her next use of homing torpedoes.

-Genji: this can be one of the hardest matchups as a melee genji can just 1v5 your backline. tell your team to buy [Iron Eyes] for a cheap way to stop his damage as he will likely have a critical strike on his melee.

-D.Va: this is the worst tank match up currently. D.Va has the mobility to go around your barrier as well as the ability to defense matrix your teams amplified damage. Try to stay close to your team and deny the D.Va from doing damage. The upside to D.Va is that she does not have the best shield break compared to the other tanks.

Note: I have not tested enough against sigma to determine if he is a harder match up than D.Va.

## Round 6

By this point you should be able to get the full build or be only a few thousand off. buy [Martian Mender]. If you can afford it buy [Rustung Von Wilhelm] or [Divine Intervention] if this is better suited in the matchup. v [Dampener Grip] can be taken so you can get more firestrikes and charges.

## Round 7

Congratulations on making it to the final round without using your barrier. If you weren't able to make it here, then it is just a skill diff. If you lose in the final round just blame your team for not shooting bullets through the barrier.

# Super-Underrated Hybrid Reinhardt build

Forge code: G26Z7

## Build Notes
This was the best [Reinhardt] build before the midseason 18 patch. The purpose of this build is to abuse the broken [Reinhardt] power [Blazing Blitz]. This power turns your ult from being okay to the best ultimate in the game. This build requires a mastery of every aspect of Reinhart's kit. No aspect if left behind. From corner swings to swing cancels. If you can master Reinhardt, you will solo carry every game you are in. A general tip for [Reinhardt] is to AFK on a corner and abuse the 3p camera. if you get a big lead, you can 2 tap a squishy before they even react. Please do not abuse this build too much. I do not want another [Reinhardt] build to get nerfed. Season 18 mi-season patch upates [Three-Tap Tommygun] is not useable on [Reinhardt] even with feeling the burn you only get about 5 or 6 ticks of damage. each firestrike takes too much of the 3 sec timer for the item for it to be worth it to take. I have not updated the round notes just incase there are any changes in the next few days. Current bugs for [Reinhardt] as of September 16 2025:

I used to take [Shield Stampede] but there is a 3p bug right now that makes it almost unplayable. take at your own risk. If you are not using 3p you should it is far superior.

## Round 1 
[Feeling the Burn] is the best power for round 1. 30% damage is a significant buff and will consistently get you kills. Try to always have the empowered swing ready when you start to attack someone. You can do this by swinging twice before you start the fight. [Heartbeat Sensor] [Weapon Grease] and [Compensator] are generally the best options.

## Round 2
[Gloomgauntlet] is the best item and it is worth it to sell everything to get it. [Aftermarket Firing Pin] is decent but not as valuable as 3 common items. [Plasma Converter] is one of the four best common items for [Reinhardt]. between these 5 items just try to utilize the most of your cash as possible. [Talon Modification Module] can be bought if you have less than 10k cash.

## Round 3
[Blazing Blitz] is the best power that Rein has. It has somehow flown under the radar as almost nobody will take it. [Blazing Blitz] turns your ultimate from situationally useful to one of the best in the game. The reason for this is that 1 swing will do the normal swing damage as well as the firestrike damage. [Phantasmic Flux] will give you damage across the board as well as significant healing. any extra cash can be spent on any previous item mentioned.

## Round 4
This is when we start to buy the hybrid items. The first one you should get is [Three-tap Tommygun] this will give attack speed which is always useful but it also gives percent damage after you use an ability. this item will allow you to dominate any tank matchup. any extra money can be used for previous items or [Wrist Wraps]

I have been recently swapping [Three-tap Tommygun] for [Superflexor] for more consistent ranged damage at the expense of more damage to tanks.

## Round 5
[Dampener Grip] will give additional attack speed and ability power, but more importantly it will reduce your cooldowns. this allows you to throw more firestrikes. since we can throw more firestrikes we will take [Magma Strike] to add some extra damage.

## Round 6
[Superflexor] will give a small amount of weapon power but will give up to 25% ability power when you deal weapon damage. since [Feeling the Burn] will trigger this we should almost always have the 25% bonus ability power after the first swing.

## Round 7
for the final item take[Hardlight Accelerator] this will give up to 25% weapon power as well as 10% cooldown reduction. it can be difficult to use enough abilities to consistently keep your stack up so alternatively you could take [Booster Jets] [Eye of the Spider][Champion's Kit] or [Chimera's Maw]. all of these items can be substituted in depending on the team compositions

Pay attention to the map as that can greatly impact which items are best for this round.

At this point [Phantasmic Flux]might not be giving enough value if the enemy has [Cybervenom] combined with the dps passive. so depending on what supports you have consider swapping for any of the optional items listed that are best for your matchup.
